Keeping my title and description when I correct an address is the right default. Please don’t overwrite text I may have edited myself. If I intentionally change it to a completely different page, a separate “refresh page details” choice could be useful later.

There’s a problem with the third test address, though: in `https://SITE.com/Article?ref=A/`, the final slash is part of `ref=A/`, so that is genuinely different from `ref=A`. It should not be treated as a duplicate. To test a harmless trailing slash, use `https://SITE.com/Article/?ref=A`; that should match `https://site.com/Article?ref=A`.

Also, when I edit the address, please reject text that isn’t a valid web link rather than saving any non-empty text. Once those points are corrected, this behaviour is right.
